lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 10 distinct vertical white lines visible on the lateral flank of the primary subject, characterized by approximately uniform spacing with higher contrast on the mid-torso segments.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: At least three line segments on the posterior flank region terminate as abbreviated dashes before reaching the lower ventral line.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Low-density grouping of 3 to 4 distinct white spots located on the upper hind limb/thigh area.

other_distinctive_markers: Visible white chevron pattern on the bridge of the snout and a white transverse band across the throat/lower neck region.
